method: A one-time walkthrough in a real browser (desktop width), shopping as a working nurse who wants a women's-fit scrub set: home page, women's collection, a best-selling set, its size guide, the cart and the return policy on dagacci.com; the same steps on Jaanuu; Dagacci's and Cozyfit's best sellers on Amazon; and a Dagacci search on Walmart. Nothing was bought and no personal details were entered.

verdict.why: For a women's fit at the lowest price: a curved V-neck and jogger set with 8 pockets and a Tall option for $19.99, 4.2★, Prime delivery and free returns. If it had to be Dagacci, I'd buy it on Amazon, not dagacci.com: the same $24.99 set comes with free returns and delivery tomorrow there, while dagacci.com makes me pay return shipping on a size I'd be guessing. With no budget limit I'd pick Jaanuu ($82): separate top and pant sizes, petite and tall, a fit finder and free returns.

likes: The price, and the page says so plainly ($25 here vs $86 for FIGS)
37 colors, sizes XS–6XL, filters by color, fabric and size
Clear pocket breakdown: 3 on the top, 5 on the pants
140 reviews right on the page (4.24★), Shop Pay and PayPal
A warm founder story and community giving
dislikes: A 10%-off email popup covered the page and swallowed my first click
Sizes read “XS(Men) / S(Women)”, and the size guide then says women should order one size smaller: I couldn't tell whether to size down once or twice
The size guide is an image deep in an accordion, not next to the sizes
Collection photos are mostly flat lays; I couldn't see the set on a woman
Spec list looks pasted from Amazon (“tuxedo shirt”, “sport type: exercise and fitness”, “T back”) and erodes trust
Returns: 14 days, I pay the return shipping, no exchanges, and the policy contradicts itself about a prepaid label
Free shipping starts at $50, and two sets come to $49.98
Small errors: “OFFCIAL” in a product name, every “You may also like” item shows (22) reviews
change: Free size exchanges, and say so next to the price
One size label per gender with the size guide (as text) next to the size buttons; drop either the dual labels or the size-down note
Show each set on a model, with the model's height and size
Replace the pasted Amazon spec list with the fabric blend in % and the 5 things a nurse cares about
Free shipping at $49 (or a 2-set bundle) and a free-shipping progress bar in the cart

likes: “Free shipping $50+ and free returns” in the top banner
Every product on a model; fabric badges (UltraLAST, UltraSOFT)
Top and pant sized separately, pants in regular, petite and tall
“Find My Size” and the size guide next to the sizes; “Model is 5'9” / Size S”
dislikes: $82 for a set, more than 3× Dagacci
A discount popup on arrival
Heavy pages: the product page kept the browser busy for about 10 seconds
A saved product link redirected to the collection

likes: Same $24.99 price with Prime delivery tomorrow and free returns
Dagacci ads show up on Cozyfit's listing
dislikes: 4.0★, the lowest of the sets I looked at
Unisex, boxy cut in the photos; nothing tells a woman how it fits
“May be available at a lower price from other sellers”
change: Lead the images with a women's on-model shot and the size chart
Win back the Buy Box from other sellers

likes: $19.99, the cheapest set I'd actually wear
Women's cut: curved V-neck and jogger, 8 pockets, Tall option
On-model photos, 4.2★ on 1,727 ratings, Prime and free returns
dislikes: Far fewer reviews than Dagacci
“Water-resistant” and similar claims I can't check

likes: Best seller badge, 4.2★ on 5,278 reviews (better than on Amazon)
Dagacci owns the search: most results are its sponsored listings
dislikes: Listings split by color and size, so reviews scatter (one twin has 222, another 1)
Titles stuffed with color and size
Surrounded by $6–15 no-name sets and Walmart's own $20 pieces rated 4.4–4.6★

Clean titles: brand, style, fit, pockets

findings.title: dagacci.com: offer free size exchanges
findings.see: Returns are 14 days with the customer paying return shipping and no exchanges; Amazon sells the same set with free returns, and Jaanuu, Cherokee and others offer free returns.
findings.why: On a $25 unisex set, return postage is a third of the price, so a shopper unsure of size buys on Amazon instead, or not at all.
do: Offer free exchanges for size (a prepaid label), and say so next to the price.
Fix the policy's contradiction about the pre-printed label and its typos.
findings.kpi: Share of dagacci.com orders vs Amazon

findings.title: dagacci.com: make sizing one clear step
findings.see: Size buttons read “XS(Men) / S(Women)” and the size guide (an image deep in the page) says women should order one size smaller, so a careful shopper can size down twice. 70% of the set's 1–2★ reviews are about fit.
findings.why: Double-adjusted sizes are the likeliest cause of the fit complaints and returns.
do: Keep the dual labels or the size-down note, not both.
Put the size chart as text next to the size buttons.
Show a model's height and size.
findings.kpi: Share of 1–2★ reviews about fit & sizing

findings.title: dagacci.com: replace the pasted Amazon specs
findings.see: The product page lists “Shirt form type: tuxedo shirt”, “Sport type: exercise and fitness”, “Back style: t back” and “Item Height: 1 Pounds”, but no fabric percentages.
findings.why: Nonsense specs make a careful shopper doubt everything else on the page.
do: List the fabric blend in % and the details a nurse checks (pockets, fit, stretch, care).
Fix “OFFCIAL” in product names and the (22) review counts in “You may also like”.

findings.title: dagacci.com: free shipping at $49, or a 2-set bundle
findings.see: Free shipping starts at $50 and two best-seller sets come to $49.98; the cart shows no free-shipping progress.
findings.why: The most common basket (two sets) just misses free shipping, the last thing a shopper sees before paying.
do: Set the threshold at $49 or sell a 2-set bundle.
Add a free-shipping progress bar to the cart.

findings.title: Walmart: merge Dagacci's split listings
findings.see: On Walmart, the same Dagacci sets appear as separate listings by color and size (one with 222 reviews, its twin with 1).
findings.why: Reviews that add up on one listing rank higher and convert better.
do: Group variants under one item with color and size options.
Shorten titles to brand, style, fit and pockets.
